units: <cite ref="Chullin 51b:14">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>אי׳ ומקרבי קיטרי</he> a net in which the knots are close.

<cite ref="Eruvin 28b:21">Erub. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אוזלתא דאיכרי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="A00601"><he>אוזילתא</he></cite>, Ar. <he>איזולתא</he>) the twist (of bunches) of the farmer.—Pl. <he>אִיזְלֵי</he>.
Erub. 8ᵃ פסק ליה לסורא באו׳ (ed. Sonc. אי׳) he separated the court-yards of Sura with nets (hurdles, matting).
